title: People’s Mañanera October 22
author: Pedro Gellert
content:
_Every day, President Claudia Sheinbaum gives a morning presidential press
conference and Mexico Solidarity Media posts English language summaries,
translated by Mexico Solidarity 's Pedro Gellert. Previous press conference
summaries are available [here](https://mexicosolidarity.com/mananera/)._

**Plan México Strengthens Domestic Industry and Creates Jobs  
** Twenty new industrial parks were announced, bringing the total to 100 as
anticipated under Plan México. With more than US$670 million in investment and
32,000 jobs to be created, President Claudia Sheinbaum emphasized that Mexico
is strengthening domestic production and reducing dependence on imports.

**“Housing for Well-Being” Program Advances in Guerrero  
** The Fourth Transformation (4T) administration has reached the 26% mark
toward its goal of 50,890 homes being delivered in the state of Guerrero, with
thousands of units currently under construction. Nationwide, the Infonavit
housing agency reports that more than 46,000 homes have been allocated in 157
housing developments.

**Serious Intervention by Foreign Agents in Chihuahua  
** Sheinbaum questioned the operation in which two U.S. agents —who were armed
and acting without authorization— were killed. The Federal Attorney General’s
Office (FGR) is investigating the incident and the complaint involving
Chihuahua Governor Maru Campos. Regarding the governor, Sheinbaum noted that
“her words speak for themselves; let the people be the judge.”

**The 4T Improves Wages and Combats Fraud at the IMSS  
** In response to the conflict involving the Mexican Social Security Institute
(IMSS), Sheinbaum highlighted the 8% wage increase, defended freedom of trade
union association, and criticized the PAN’s opportunism. In addition, she
announced measures against massive fraud in Modality 40 pensions to protect
workers’ retirement funds.
